newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota, Honda rise on stability of the yen.
newsitem.headline: Toyota, Honda rise on stability of the yen.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp and Honda Motor Co Ltd firmed on Monday morning as investors, encouraged by a stable yen, moved to buy the shares which had retreated due to strength in the yen, brokers said.
As of 0043 GMT, Toyota was up 130 yen at 3,550, the fifth most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse with trade totalling 1.59 million shares.
"The shares, despite the recent correction are still at fairly high levels and the buying may not continue," a broker at a middle-sized brokerage said.
